resolutions.researcher_notes: SPEC/CONCERN, new this pass. The Jiangxi provincial 14th-FYP energy-infrastructure project roster (sohu.com, dated 2021, '（三）能源基础设施领域（44项）' itemized list of 44 named projects, opened as one of the 12 previously-unopened harvest_pool_live URLs) lists '广丰支线' (Guangfeng branch) as item 25 and '玉山支线' (Yushan branch) as item 26 -- TWO SEPARATE line items, not one combined 'Guangfeng-Yushan Branch'. This is the same provincial roster that separately and exactly matches P4786 (item 23, 赣州南支线（会昌-寻乌段）), P4788 (item 21, 赣州南支线（信丰-瑞金段）) and P5888 (item 35, 万载-铜鼓支线) as single combined items each -- so the list's convention for a genuinely single/combined project is to give it ONE item number, which sharpens the significance of Guangfeng and Yushan getting TWO. Combined with the already-known tension that no source has ever been found giving a single length/status figure for a combined 'Guangfeng-Yushan Branch' as GEM models it (batch_07's Length/FuelSource both UNRESOLVED, Status only 'unclear'), this raises a genuine existence/classification question: is GEM's P5887 actually two separate provincial branches merged into one row+route, or one row correctly representing a single physical branch that the province's own roster happens to list in two administrative pieces (Guangfeng District and Yushan County each getting a line item for their own portion of one continuous pipe)? Cross-shard check performed (grepped all of batch_01/03/04/07/08/14/99_crossshard.json for 'P5887', '广丰', '玉山', 'Guangfeng', 'Yushan') -- no existing __VALIDITY__ record for this row despite batch_07's Length note referencing '(see __VALIDITY__ below)', which was never actually filed; this record fills that gap. NOT recommending a split or deletion -- flagging for human review given the roster evidence is suggestive, not dispositive (a two-item roster listing is consistent with either reading).
